nom: VANICREAM Gentle Facial Cleanser for Sensitive Skin

avis.titre: did not work for my skin type
avis.texte: this product is gentle, hydrating , non scented and great for daily use. i have oily /acne prone skin. so this product is not ideal for me.

avis.titre: The most important ingredient really is trust
avis.texte: I trust Vanicream to provide all of my personal care products. They are the only company I have found that actually formulates products for allergic/reactive/sensitive skin types like mine and my daughters. We've tried "toxin free"/ "natural, organic" brands only to be left with raw, bumpy, itchy, inflamed skin and scalps. The Vanicream shampoo and conditioner clean our scalps and provides softness and shine all without the fragrance, itch, flakes and back acne. The gel gives my waves definition and keeps the frizz at bay. The face wash and body wash clean without leaving us dry or red. Also, there is no residue or smell, not even a lingering chemical one. We just smell like nothing which is what clean should smell like. Only recently did we switch from a popular brand of moisturizer with ceramides to Vanicream moisturizing lotion. Turns out the popular brand was giving us zits and blackheads and somehow also making us feel dry? Not vanicreams lotion. Our skin feels hydrated and more importantly we don't notice our skin which says it all. I also don't feel like I need "anti-aging" products anymore. I did try the vanicream face moisturizer but something in it broke me out (glyceryl stearate maybe?) but the moisturizing lotion makes my face skin look amazing so I'm cool with that. We hope to try the deodorant next too! Thank you Vanicream for caring about the health of your customers. If you keep the formulas the same we will keep buying. You really have made our lives a little
This product is amazing. It works really well for sensitive. Skin doesn't leave your skin feeling dry. I definitely will be buying this again.

I just got this and am a first time user. I have PD and they breakouts can get pretty bad, but this cleanser is so gentle, but also a deep clean feel too! As of now I am a lover and support this whole heartedly, and I hope it continues to work wonders for me!

I was hesitant to purchase because I've had experience with other brands gentle cleansers that just don't feel like my face is being cleaned. This succeeded my expectations and I would definitely purchase again.
This cleanser got in my eyes several times when washing my face and burned so bad I felt sick . It took an entire night to get the irritation to stop. It's definitely not for contact with eyes .

avis.titre: I will buy this  product again, again, again,again,again....
avis.texte: I have had rosacea reactive sensitive skin a LONG time. So I think I've tried everything and all cleansers. And I had orange peel chin with white hard bumps I would pic open with a needle. I've seen this cleanser for awhile so I thought I'd try it. In a matter of days my chin improved GREATLY and the redness from rosacea is gone. I wash my face and look up in the mirror and I see normal skin!!!!! So I have invested in the whole line and I 'm NOT GOING BACK to anything I HAVE USED BEFORE. For me this is the HOLY GRAIL!!

I've been using this product on both my face and body, since the retailer I was shopping at was out of the body wash. I do intend to try the body wash when I can, but right now, this facial cleanser is working extremely well on both my face and body. It lathers well, cleanses thoroughly, rinses cleanly, and doesn't make my skin angry. It's a bit pricey, but worth every penny.

avis.titre: Gentle and great for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have super sensitive, acne-prone skin and need a cleanser that won't strip my barrier away but also won't leave any makeup or oils that might contribute to acne. Vanicream is the answer! I've used it for years and recommend it for folks who need a gentle, fragrance-free cleanser that won't break you out.

I bought this in the 2.5 ounce size to try it. Unfortunately at the first try, it irritated my eyelids so badly that I will never use it on my face again. I had been using the La Roche Posay Toleriance Dermo-Cleaner, and I mainly got this because I wanted a travel size tube. Anyway this is a no-go for me and I will be going back to the LRP, which has never irritated me in any way.

This is amazing for sensitive skin. My husband and I both use it. I use it daily and it has been a real game changer for my VERY dry and red skin. My husband uses it 5 days a week while also using Nizoral 2 days a week for his pityrosporum folliculitis and seborrheic dermatitis. It works so great as a gentle cleanser for the other days for him. Again this has been a real game changer for us both!! Highly recommend it and yes we DID actually purchase it and did NOT get this as a incentivized review.

avis.titre: Love the product hate the pump.
avis.texte: I have been a vanicream facial wash buyer for years now. Here recently in the last year every product that I buy the pump eventually goes out and it won't pump any longer and I have to pour in my hand
I needed a new cleanser to gently remove my makeup and this was recommended by my dermatologist. She uses it, too. Bonus: its affordable!

avis.titre: I cannot buy this product again…
avis.texte: I started using Vanicream after I started getting rashes on my face and neck. I went to a dermatologist after the rashes never would go away completely and of course she said to keep using the Vanicream so I trusted her. I ended doing my own homework and it turns out I am allergic to acrylates which are in many Vanicream products. Luckily for me I can still use some of the other Vanicream products…be careful out there though, acrylates may be safe for some but the allergy to acrylates is on the rise and in so many products on the market, even those considered safe!
Removes makeup with out striping your skin. Clean and affordable 👍

avis.titre: Gentle, thorough, and great for sensitive, acne-prone skin
avis.texte: I have PCOS, so my skin is acne-prone and sensitive. This cleanser keeps my breakouts at bay without being overly drying. The odorless foaming formula removes whatever makeup and sunscreen my cleansing balm misses, leaving my skin soft and supple. 10/10!
This is a great, basic cleanser that is fail-proof. Great for sensitive skin like mine. Foams well, no fragrance, and great for on a budget.

My skin has been freaking out with this weird weather, and none of my products were helping. I ordered some KBeauty skincare from YesStyle, but it was taking too long, so I decided to try Vanicream. My skin was peeling and SUPER itchy before using the Vanicream cleanser. After washing and using the moisturizer, I noticed a difference right away. DEF is worth a shot if you're experiencing something similar. The cleanser is more on the watery side, but it can bubble up if you use enough product. My skin didn't itch after washing with this, so I knew it was a good sign. I've been using this for almost two weeks, and it's probably my new daily cleanser.

Really been loving this face wash. It actually cleans without stripping my skin of all moisture. It feels so silky on my skin too. It doesnt feel like its doing nothing. Its not breaking me out either!

I started using this from month my skin feels calm and acne as well. My son is also using he is also acne prone and it suits him well . Also its so cheap. My skin is super sensitive, acne-prone, and clog-prone and this cleanser cleanses just enough without stripping or leaving any residue so it doesn't break me out. Its super affordable and accessible and Vanicream is cruetly free. A perfect cleanser IMO.
Before I was using a fancy double cleansing method but this cleanser feels so gentle on my skin and I haven't broken out.
This is my go-to, all-around facial cleanser. It cleanses my skin well, and does not strip my skin of moisture. It is a wonderful value for the money spent. I would recommend this product.

Otherwise, I like that it is very gentle on my face, and the redness on my face has been reduced, while I stopped all facial products except for at night. I will continue to use this facial cleanser. If you were a lot of makeup, or foundation, I recommend removing the make up before using this cleanser.
Great cleanser- my face is dry and oily and this works great! Tried on vacation and love it!

works so good, bless the person who made this. i hope you get everything youve ever dreamed of

Very gentle, not drying, but also suitable for combo skin. I even tried other brands like Youth to the People in the middle, but they could never beat this.

I've been buying this product since I was in 9th Grade. THIS IS MY FOR-LIFER FACIAL WASH. This is such a gentle face wash. I've been blessed with not being bothered by too much acne. This facial wash plus a good toner is all I've ever needed. 10/10

Seriously, what a gem of a product. After years of treating my acne like I was waging war on it, I finally to step back and reevaluate my approach. This cleanser is a gentle and effective step in my double-cleansing routine at night. It doesn't have any harsh ingredients meant to melt the acne off my face, and yet somehow, I've never had more clear, smooth, or glossy skin. As a cleanser only spends a short amount of time on your skin, it's better to go with a cost-effective product without irritants, fragrances, etc., even as someone who doesn't struggle with sensitive skin or allergies to common skincare ingredients. Invest big $$ in your serums instead (if you still wanr high-end products), but don't hold out on this amaaazing product either.

I have historically been a Neutrogena and Cerve girlie, but I will never give this up. I have always been acne prone then adulthood triggered rosacea. After a terrible flare up I switched to only Vanicream products and they keep my face satisfied and calm.

This is now my favorite face cleanser. I tend to break out easily, and my skin is also sensitive to ingredients like fragrances and dyes. This cleanser doesn't contain any of those irritants and feels very gentle. I used to be a loyal user of a well-known liquid cleanser (the one that starts with "C" and ends with "E"), but after they changed the formula, my skin became more irritated and I started breaking out more often. I was really relieved to find an affordable option that's made for sensitive skin, avoids harsh ingredients, and still helps prevent breakouts.

I used to use neutrogena gentle cleanser but when i ran out, i bought vanicream and i love it and forever my staple item. I buy other cleansers - mind you - pricer cleansers like Dieux but i keep going back to Vanicream. I feel like genuinely clean but not stripped like at all. I love its non comodogenic and its literally so simple ingredient wise - my skin is prone to redness and it calms my redness down, It is genuinely made for dry skin so i do understand why other customers with combo & oily skin may break out. I feel like i got maybe less acne for my skin with this cleanser but i also just get occasional pimples, and its also good as a second cleanser for wearing make up. If youre just looking for a simple cleanser, get this! Their other products are good too

I hightly recommend this cleanser to anyone with sensitive, acne-prone skin who has struggled finding a cleanser that is gentle enough to not irritate the skin, but sufficient enough to properly cleanse the skin in order to avoid breakouts. I've tried many low-end and high-end cleansers and this cleanser takes the cake. It's important to keep in mind that everyone's skin is different and there is always a chance that an ingredient doesn't work for you. Given the price point though, this cleanser is really worth anyone trying

The best cleanser hands down. I've been using cerave for years and didn't know it was killing my skin barrier. It was always red and inflamed. This cleanser is so gentle and doesn't irritate my dry super sensitive skin

I wanted to love and try this product. I swtiched from Cetaphil (no problems) to this. First day I used this and it dried out my skin. Second day I used it, it made my skin turn red and itchy all over. Third day, my skin started to peel and I developed a whole rash under my eyes and on the top of my eyelids and my pimples I have got worse! I have a painful red rash and it burns bad even when I put lotion. I have to cut out my skincare routine for now and do nothing!!!!!

avis.titre: I wanted to like this so bad!!
avis.texte: Im very conflicted on this product! Overall, the cleanser did cleanse my skin very well. It removed all dirt & makeup. My skin did not feel dry after use either, it felt balanced. HOWEVER, there is an ingredient in this that my skin did NOT take well to. The existing pimples I already had became more inflamed & would not heal. In fact, it seemed to clog the pimples more causing them to enlarge & become painful. I think this product just really depends on your skin type. I'm not sure its the best product for acne prone skin, but if you're looking to fix texture & oiliness this may work for you.
I have dry skin with occasional eczema flare ups and heard about this through a dermatologist and other Tik Toks. Its very moisturizing, a little goes a long way, and it does not irrate my skin.

I love this product. It is very gentle and doesn't leave skin dry or oily. It is great for clearing my skin and is gentle enough to use daily. Very good product. I would highly recommend. It is a fabulous brand.
so far rlly good with rebuilding skin barrier and it's great for sensitive skin.

I was diagnosed with Rosacea a few months ago. Before my diagnosis, I had tried tirelessly to find skincare products that would help clear up my red, itchy, burning, and dry patchy skin. NOTHING worked. It seemed as if everything I tried only itritated my skin more. If I spent 10 dollars or close to 100 dollars, it was all for nothing. I finally saw a derm who gave me a prescription for a cream that was suppose to help and clear up the redness and "demodex" but that cream burned like the dickens!!! After doing a ton of research, I came across this cleanser and thought, "well I've tried everything else, including my prescription cream, what do I have to lose?" Let me tell you…this cleanser has changed my life!!!!! After only a few days of using it, along with the moisturizer, my skin had cleared up almost completey!!!! My face has not looked this good in 2 years!!!! I have been using this in combination with the moisturizer every night and every morning for a little over a month now, and my results have been AMAZING!!! Everyone's skin is different, and everyone's skin issues are different, so definitely seek treatment by a derm FIRST, but if all else fails, give this a try!!

I used to have oily skin, but now that I'm older I have dry sensitive skin. Every cleanser I used was either too harsh now, too drying, wouldn't remove all my makeup or would cause breakouts. I tried this and it helped; I'm not using any other cleansers now. I love it!

I'm surprised how much I like this. I like my Vanicream in a tub a lot, and this is a wonderful cleanser for my aging, combo skin. It feels like it really cleans but is so gentle. Using it is very pleasant; no smell, smooth and lovely texture.

avis.titre: Has been my everyday for 5 years now

I've never looked back since :) i repurchase this every single month!!!
I have perioral dermatitis and was dealing with a bad flare up and nothing would help. I tossed all my skin care and started using this wash & have had no issues since

avis.titre: Go to cleanser - simple and works
avis.texte: i have been using this for a while and it is my go to as a simple and fragrance free cleanser for sensitive, oily skin

My only cons are that it smells like chemicals and I can not find a bigger size to buy.
Love this cleanser. It is gentle but still lathers really nice and makes my skin feel clean. Perfect for my sensitve and acne prone skin. The ingreident list is super simple.

I really like this cleanser. It never burns, it cleans effectively, and it doesn't strip my face. It's simple for a reason and that has been really beneficial to my sensitive, breakout prone, hormone-controlled skin!

My dermatologist recommended this cleanser for my extremely sensitive eczema prone skin. It is the only cleanser that does not break me out and gets my face very clean even when I wear makeup. Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

Everyone else was dealing with breakouts first semester except for me!!!!!!!!! It also cleared up my skin after surgery. It's genuinley such a good simple cleanser, it does exactly what it needs to do, and has never irritated my sensitive skin!

First time trying this and I was surprised. It lathers nice and moisturizes my dry mature skin. It has no scent which is great and leaves my skin feeling good. It's actually a great facial cleanser. If you want to try something different this is a great option.

This has been my go-to cleanser for years! I have type 2 rosacea and very dry, sensitive skin and this cleanser doesn't irritate any of that. It's hydrating, affordable, and frangrance free. Can't say enough good things about it! :)

The Vanicream Gentle Facial Cleanser is perfect for sensitive skin! It's fragrance-free, super gentle, and effectively cleanses without leaving my skin feeling dry or tight. I love how simple and soothing the formula is, making it a staple in my skincare routine. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a no-nonsense, effective cleanser!

I should've read the ingredients like I always do, but I just wanted something simple and effective. But after a few days of using it, my redness was exacerbated and my forehead was red and riddled with painful breakouts. I do believe Mica was the culprit :/ my skin is sensitive and reactive, and Mica is unsafe for sensitive users, even though it's been marketed to be generally safe for skin. I would avoid it if you can, even if your skin is healthy. Bought skknfix gel cleanser jnstead :)

I ran into some terrible skin issues for the first time in life going through my 20's. My dermatologist recommend a few products with Vanicream being one. Long story short, I stuck with Vanicream and haven't had any issues since! I have sensitive skin, and being a black woman and getting terrible sunburn was definitely a shocker for me! These products have been a blessing to my skin for almost 5 years now! -face wash -sunscreen -moisturizer -vit c serum

I'm 47, allergic to everything, and have combination skin....sometimes I'll get the random break-out, sometimes I'm dry and flakey. I have tried everything....EVERYTHING. Price point of $ to $$$$. This is just the best for me. No weird smells, doesn't burn, doesn't strip and leave me dry and gets all my make-up off. All I can say is TRY IT, it may be the perfect facewash for you.

I have eczema so I need a gentle cleanser. This is very gentle and gives me a little bit of a foam that I like. So it is the best of both worlds

My dermatologist recommended this cleanser as my skin is very sensitive and the ingredient list is super simple/minimal. Was nice for a while, but eventually I noticed that my cheeks and other parts of my face were getting super dry. I have combination, rosacea prone, sensitive skin for reference. I had stopped using the cleanser to see if that was what was causing the issues with dry skin/stripped skin barrier. Soon found out that the cleanser was the cause! Which was very disappointing, especially with how basic the ingredient list is. I had to stop using the cleanser immediately and switched to a different one, which thankfully hydrated my skin and helped repair my barrier over time. I will never use this cleanser again nor recommend it to my friends or family. Very disappointed that this cleanser did this to my face.
